issues.description: The Bitmap24 class member 'width' is declared as type 'short' in the template repository header but as type 'int' in the solution repository header. This attribute type mismatch between template and solution can confuse students who compare their work with the reference: code examples, arithmetic and buffer allocations in Bitmap24.cpp use 'width' in expressions (width * height * 3) and assume an int-sized dimension. The inconsistency may lead students to wonder which type is intended and may introduce subtle narrowing/overflow concerns or differences when comparing template behavior to the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Bitmap24 member types consistent across template and solution. Prefer using 'int width;' (as in the solution) in the template header so both repositories declare width and height with the same type. Update the template's example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp to declare 'int width;' to match the solution and avoid narrowing/ambiguity.
